items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to authorizing the creation of mental health matters license plates; and to amend the state finance law, in relation to the mental illness anti-stigma fund
items.lawCode: Amd §404-dd, V & T L; amd §95-h, St Fin L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S1210

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law and the
state finance law, in relation to authorizing the creation of mental
health matters license plates; and to amend the state finance law, in
relation to the mental illness anti-stigma fund

 PURPOSE: :

This legislation would create the Mental Health Matters license plate.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS: :

Section 1 creates the Mental Health Maters license plate. Any person
residing in the state may request a mental health matters license
plate as developed and approved by the Commissioner, who shall work
with the Commissioner of OMH in its creation. Such license plate shall
bare the phrases "Healthy mind, healthy New York" and End the Stigma
of Mental illness". Issuance of such plates shall come with an annual
service charge of $25. This money shall be credited to the mental
illness anti stigma fund established by section 95-h of the State
Finance Law.

Section 2 allows for funds from the plate to be accepted and deposited
into the mental illness anti stigma fund.

Section 3 Contains language relating to the financing of the creation
of the Mental Health Matters license plate.

Section 4 is the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION: :

The intent of this legislation is to help end the stigma of mental
illness. In recent years New York has taken steps in this direction
including policies such as calling for mental health education in our
schools. This legislation continues to help bring public awareness and
education to mental illness. It is through various awareness campaigns
that we are able to make the citizens of New York truly aware and more
understanding of mental health issues and how those issues can affect
not only their fellow New Yorkers, but themselves.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: :

New Bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

Minimal.

 EFFECTIVE DATE: :

This act shall take effect 180 days after it shall have become law.
